summary: Kiskadee Watch, the Guyanese outlet the BBC credits as the origin of this account, carries testimony from four survivors. Elena Moonsammy states she lost seven relatives and that boxes stowed at the rear shifted. A survivor identified as Adreiena states the engine stopped twice before departure and that no pump was available when water entered. Businessman Donald Modeste states the vessel was stuck on a sandbank at the wharf and then sailed on one engine. A fourth survivor describes about six hours in the water.

Reports the five-member Commission of Inquiry named on 26 July, independently of the Guyana Chronicle, and states it was appointed under Section 2(1) of the Commissions of Inquiry Act. Sets out each commissioner's stated background, and reports previously published matters concerning three of them, each without a finding of wrongdoing. States that questions raised locally about a possible conflict of interest affecting one commissioner were unanswered at press time.
